name: 泥潭6
english_description: A large NT/nitan ('Mire') lineage wuxia mudlib built on a creation myth — Pangu splitting heaven and earth, yin and yang emerging from chaos — and spanning over 23,000 source files, making it one of the largest games in this collection. Its signature touch is a 'birth ceremony': after registering, a new character isn't considered fully 'born' until they travel to the Registration realm and complete a ritual dialogue with mythic NPCs like Pangu and Ksitigarbha, weaving the tutorial gate directly into the game's own mythology rather than just an email-confirmation step.
